text:
carmen: spotted intermittent p95 spikes on /v1/embeddings during a downstream load test. heatmap shows correlation with requests claiming high dims but without x-embed-dim header. https://dash.redwood.ai/q/embeds :eyes:

metrics-bot: ALERT: embeddings.p95 > 600ms (3m)  impacted tenants: 8 (hot: inc-analytics)

drew: can we avoid exploding metric cardinality by mapping dims to a finite set? current tag emit `embed.dim=2048` creates thousands of series

yusuf: agree. propose dim_buckets: tiny(<=64), std(65-512), wide(513-2048), huge(>2048). keep values short to limit label cardinality

carmen: sounds good. additionally, clients often omit header -> router falls back to sniffing which adds latency. we should encourage `x-rwd-embed-dim` from SDKs and console.

raja: important: do NOT sample quota counters. billing/quota must remain exact. sampling only for traces/histograms/verbose telemetry

drew: sampling idea: tenant-consistent hashing + per-bucket rates so we capture latency across tenants without overwhelming metrics pipeline. e.g. tiny=5%, std=2%, wide=0.5%, huge=0.1%

yusuf: implement ingress logic: compute bucket from header if present else mark client_hint=sniffed and bucket after minimal sniff. emit a minimal counter always and sampled latency histograms when chosen

metrics-bot: NOTE: dashboards using `by(embed.dim)` will break. update queries to `by(dim_bucket)` or join with the new `embed_dim_hist` if we expose raw dims in a debug stream

carmen: rollout plan: feature flag `embeds.dim_v2` behind which ingress emits dim_bucket + sampling. Canary 10% tenants (low-traffic) for 48h, then 50% for 24h, then wide. Keep debug export of raw dims for 0.1% events for calibration

drew: dashboards: I'll add dim_bucket panels (p50/p95/p99) and a tenant vs bucket heatmap. Will also add annotations for flag flips. owners: carmen (docs/SDK), drew (dashboards), yusuf (ingress+sampling), raja (billing)

yusuf: nits: add label `client_hint` values limited to `sdk_hint|none|sniffed` and `sampling_ver` so we can evolve policy without mixing series

carmen: I'll draft a 1-pager + lightweight sequence diagram (client -> ingress(bucket+counter) -> router -> runtime -> metrics). aiming to post by EOD. canary target next Tue after quick QA

raja: request: run a 14-day backfill to compute bucket baselines before enabling alerts. we should mute new per-bucket alerts until baselines are trustworthy

drew: agree. once 1-pager is up i'll open dashboard PRs and canary config. thanks all :thumbsup:
